name: Astral Resilience
description: Once per battle, surviving an enemy attack while below 25% HP restores 10 Mana.
activationLines: Astral Resilience activates! A faint Astral glow steadies you as you recover 10 Mana.
Astral Resilience activates! Starlight flickers around you, answering your determination with 10 restored Mana.
Astral Resilience activates! A stubborn spark of Astral energy refuses to let you falter, restoring 10 Mana.
Astral Resilience activates! The stars seem to notice you're having a rough time and quietly return 10 Mana.
